dataset: University of Ottawa Rolling-element Dataset - Vibration and Acoustic Faults under Constant Load and Speed conditions (UORED-VAFCLS)
excluded_column_reason: Speed and load were only nonzero in the inspected raw capture metadata row; they were excluded from the signal model.
rul: not trained; the dataset descriptions identify healthy/developing/faulty states but no time interval or failure-time ground truth was assigned here
holdout: Five-fold grouped validation; each fold holds out one physical bearing ID from each fault family, keeping each bearing healthy/developing/faulty captures together.
